description: Evaluate deterministic mathematical expressions with optional variables. Use for algebra, matrices, vectors, transformations, descriptive numerical checks, and reproducible calculations. Does not execute arbitrary JavaScript or install packages.

expression.description: MathJS expression, e.g. mean(values), std(values), multiply(A, b), inv(A).

variables.description: Variables available to the expression. Values must be numbers, strings, vectors, or matrices.
